title: The Faster Spindle
brief: Engineering at Meridian Works proposes raising the spindle speed on machine 7 by 20 percent for part 5512, which has a critical bore diameter. Change request CR-064 is ready for sign-off. You have 12 visit points to assess whether the change has been reviewed for risks, controls, and records.

actions.label: Process engineer: who reviewed the change
General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Current process sheet at the machine
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Calibration status of bore gauge BG-3
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Planned start date for the new speed
Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: CR-064 states the reason (cycle time), the parts affected, and the approver roles. It is not yet signed.
evidence.whyItMatters: A change request that states purpose, scope, and approvers is a sound start.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The request form is complete for its stage. Conforming.

evidence.text: Trial results for CR-064 cover 8 parts on one shift; bore diameters were measured on only 3 of them. No acceptance criteria are stated for the trial.
evidence.whyItMatters: A change must be reviewed to show that outputs will still conform. A trial with no criteria and a small, partly measured sample does not show that.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask what the trial was meant to prove and whether the data proves it.

evidence.text: Process engineer: "Quality will see it at sign-off." No quality or production reviewer is named in the review section yet (form section 4).
evidence.whyItMatters: Bringing the right reviewers in early improves a change. At this stage it is an observation, since sign-off has not happened.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask who has reviewed the change so far.

evidence.text: Risk assessment RA-5512 was last updated 2 years ago and does not consider spindle speed. CR-064 makes no reference to it.
evidence.whyItMatters: Risks to conformity from a planned change should be identified and addressed.
evidence.missedExplanation: Link every change to the risk record of the product it affects.

evidence.text: Customer requirements file for part 5512 states that process changes must be notified to the customer before shipment (clause 9 of agreement 22). CR-064 has no customer notification step.
evidence.whyItMatters: Customer requirements on changes must be reviewed and met.
evidence.missedExplanation: Read the customer file for change notification terms.

evidence.text: Process sheet PS-5512 revision 4 at machine 7 matches the register.
evidence.whyItMatters: The current approved settings are at the machine until the change is approved.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The sheet is current. The change has not been implemented, which is correct.

evidence.text: Bore gauge capability study was done at the old cycle time; it shows the gauge uses 35 percent of the tolerance. CR-064 does not consider measurement capability.
evidence.whyItMatters: Measuring resources must be suitable for the checks made. A gauge using a large share of the tolerance may not detect a small shift caused by the change.
evidence.missedExplanation: Ask whether the measurement system can detect the effect of the change.

evidence.text: Bore gauge BG-3 is within its calibration date (due in 4 months).
evidence.whyItMatters: The gauge is calibrated. Calibration alone does not show it is capable for the check.
evidence.missedExplanation: This record leads to the capability study.

evidence.text: Training plan for CR-064 is blank; the change alters the warm-up routine that 6 operators follow.
evidence.whyItMatters: People affected by a change need the competence to apply it.
evidence.missedExplanation: Look for the people side of a change: instructions and training.

evidence.text: Planning shows the new speed starting next Monday, 4 days before the planned sign-off date.
evidence.whyItMatters: Implementation must not start before the change is approved. The dates conflict; it is an observation while the change is unsigned.
evidence.missedExplanation: Compare planned start with the approval date.

evidence.text: The capacity chart shows machine 7 at 96 percent load.
evidence.whyItMatters: High load explains the reason for the change but is not itself a quality issue.
evidence.falseFindingNote: Load is the business reason for the change, not a nonconformity.

evidence.text: The machine guard is closed and the interlock works when tested by the operator.
evidence.whyItMatters: Guarding is a safety matter outside this quality review and is working.
evidence.falseFindingNote: The guard works. Safety controls are outside this case and showed no issue.

decisions.prompt: Should CR-064 be signed this week?
options: Yes, the cycle time gain is needed
No. Return it with conditions: defined trial criteria and a full measured sample, updated risk assessment, gauge capability check, training, and customer notification
Yes, but only for night shift
decisions.rationale: The change may well be sound, but the review is incomplete. Returning it with clear conditions keeps the benefit while protecting conformity.

containment: Keep machine 7 at the current approved speed until CR-064 is approved
correction: Complete CR-064: trial criteria, measured sample, risk update, capability check, training plan, and customer notification
cause: The change form does not prompt for risk, measurement capability, training, or customer notification
corrective: Add these prompts and a cross-functional review step to the change request form
effectiveness: Audit the next five change requests for complete reviews before implementation

debriefText.found: You assessed the change against its risks, measurements, people, and customer terms.
debriefText.missed: A change review asks: will output still conform, can we measure it, do people know, and does the customer need to be told?
debriefText.falseFinding: The business reason and safety guarding were not quality gaps in this change.
